races.paceDynamic: Overbudget and Skip To Victory will clash from the gates, creating a genuine speed duel in this small field of six. With no other natural front-runners, this early battle should set up a strong gallop that will suit closers Button It and Star Marian, while Ring Of Diamonds may find herself caught between the pace and the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Speed Duel Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Overbudget and Skip To Victory burn each other out in their early battle
scenarios.body: The two pace-setters fade badly in the final furlong after going too fast early. Button It and Star Marian sweep past the tiring leaders to contest the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Overbudget Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Overbudget gets first run and Skip To Victory settles behind rather than challenging
scenarios.body: Overbudget builds a decisive lead while Skip To Victory tracks, then Skip To Victory rallies strongly to catch the leader near the line. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground on the strong pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Slowdown Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If neither pace-setter wants to make the running and they go off steadily
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Overbudget's superior rating tells. Skip To Victory and Ring Of Diamonds also benefit from the moderate early pace to stay competitive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Perfect Timing
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough but Button It or Star Marian gets a perfect trip through
scenarios.body: One of the closers times their run to perfection while the front-runners pay for their early efforts. The winner comes from last to first in the final two furlongs.

races.paceDynamic: With only Bizou as a confirmed front runner and the majority being hold-up horses, this will develop into a steadily-run race lacking early pressure. Bizou can dictate comfortable fractions uncontested, while prominent runners Danehill Star, Phyllis Burton, The Pug and Man Is King settle just behind, creating a compressed field entering the straight where the numerous hold-up horses will need luck in running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bizou Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Bizou gets soft fractions and stays strong late
scenarios.body: The front runner maintains a sustainable gallop without pressure and has enough left to resist late challengers. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground despite the good going.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and kick is decisive
scenarios.body: The steady gallop plays into the hands of the strong finishers who can unleash their turn of foot. Marinakis and Wyvern benefit from their excellent going records and closing style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If a handy runner finds the perfect position and timing
scenarios.body: One of the horses tracking Bizou gets first run and capitalizes before the hold-up brigade can respond. Their forward position proves decisive in a race lacking early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If extremely steady fractions create a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed results in a bunched field and multiple hard-luck stories in running. Pure stamina and racing room become the determining factors.

races.paceDynamic: Grand Echo will take the field along as the only confirmed front-runner, with Jane Of The Jungle and Woody Y Fernandez providing some early company in prominent positions. scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Echo gets soft fractions with minimal early pressure

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Grand Echo sets reasonable pace but tires in final furlong
scenarios.body: The slow early tempo perfectly sets up the hold-up horses who time their challenges perfectly. Multiple closers converge with A Lott Of Kane and Frankali benefiting from their patient tactics.

scenarios.trigger: If Jane Of The Jungle or Woody Y Fernandez track Grand Echo closely
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the hold-up traffic while staying close enough to the pace. Jane Of The Jungle's recent second suggests she's ready to capitalize from her forward position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Echo goes too fast early under pressure from prominent horses
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the field bunches up, creating a cavalry charge finish. An outsider like Sequential or Mon Petit Frere sneaks through the gaps as favorites struggle.
